stories.title: World Series champs, at last! Milwaukee Brewers barrel their way to the top
stories.summary: After a 57-year drought, one of the game's great franchises has its first championship.

stories.title: Brewers close out Rays to capture first World Series title in franchise history
stories.summary: The Brewers dispatched the Rays in Game 5 of the World Series on Wednesday night, cementing the first title in the franchise's 57-year history.

stories.title: Contreras wins World Series MVP, proclaims himself 'best catcher in the world'
stories.summary: Brewers catcher William Contreras capped his stellar postseason run by winning World Series MVP honors after batting .381 and winning 10 of 13 ABS appeals.

stories.title: Rays 'crushed' but proud as unexpected season ends in World Series loss
stories.summary: There were tears and heartache in the Rays' clubhouse after their season ended in Wednesday's Game 5 loss to the Brewers, but, above all, there was pride.

stories.title: Harbaugh: Winless Chargers to stick with McDaniel as offensive playcaller
stories.summary: Embattled offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel will continue as the Chargers' playcaller, coach Jim Harbaugh announced Wednesday.
